description.value: Neighbour's Restaurant & Pizza House is a second-generation, family-owned Greek-Italian establishment on Victoria Drive that has been serving Vancouver since 1982. The menu spans souvlaki, spanakopita, wood-style pizza, and a full cocktail bar, reflecting its Italian-with-a-Greek-touch identity. The restaurant regularly accommodates large groups and private parties and offers online ordering with delivery through major platforms.
